payload.body: vc to all Utilz nodes: until utilz-dc fixes the test-home leak (an issue in 2.14.1), syncz.bats writes unison archives into the real archive dir, about 18 a run (on this Mac, ~/Library/Application Support/Unison, beside hv's own syncs), and cryptz.bats runs gpg on the real home. Keep both out of Mac runs that do not need them, and a whole-suite run that must include them says so in its START. dc's kovacs legs already keep both homes inside the run dir.
